name: recipe-card
title: Recipe card
description: A recipe in a card: photo, title, total time with prep and cook in a tooltip, difficulty, servings, dietary marks as words and a rating.
docs: time is minutes in all (45) or { prep, cook, total? } in minutes: it is written in the locale's short units ('45 min', '1 hr 15 min'), and when both prep and cook are given the breakdown opens in a tooltip on hover, on focus and on a tap (a press of the button toggles it, so a touch screen and a screen reader reach it too, and a tap outside closes it; the total is prep plus cook unless you give it). difficulty is easy, medium or hard, written as a word beside three small bars; servings reads 'Serves 4'. dietary is a list of words and every one is shown, so nobody has to open the recipe to learn that it holds nuts or dairy: never icons alone. rating (0 to 5) and ratingCount draw the stars and are read as one sentence ('Rated 4.6 from 212 reviews'); a count of 0 says 'No reviews yet'. title is the one link of the card (href, with onOpen for a client-side router; without an href but with onOpen it becomes a button), and image falls back to a quiet 'No photo yet' tile, also when the picture fails to load. The heart beside the title is a toggle with aria-pressed, named with the recipe ('Save Lemon ricotta pasta as a favourite'): controlled with saved and onSave, or uncontrolled with defaultSaved. Without saved or onSave it keeps its own state, so a prototype works at once; saveable={false} removes it. It is its own target above the card's link. labels carries every word.
